name: near-uniform
why: Pins the derived nearUniform flag (SPEC §8B, docs/adr/0021 D3) from BOTH sides of the tolerance. n = 4, so uniform is 0.25 per option and the rule is max|p - 1/n| <= 0.05, inclusive. boundary_inside sits at a maximum deviation of 0.0499 and boundary_outside at 0.0501 — 1e-4 either side, which is four orders of magnitude clear of double-precision noise, so no port needs an epsilon to decide it. Without these two a port can pick any tolerance and no test notices.
